e: Tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants / a noise resembling the bark of a dog.

Tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants; a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds.
The residue that remains when something is burned / any of various deciduous pinnate-leaved ornamental or timber trees of the genus Fraxinus.
